a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a big, dark cloud in the sky. She knew that meant it was going to rain soon.
Lily ran inside her house and told her mommy, "Mommy, it's going to rain soon. I want to play outside." Her mommy said, "Okay, but you need to stay inside until the rain stops."
Lily was sad because she wanted to play outside. She asked her mommy, "Can we play inside?" Her mommy said
